versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI Reliability Layer micro-services

- Three pay-per-call endpoints: /fix-json, /validate-output, /generate-structured
- /fix-json: Automatically corrects malformed JSON from LLMs (e.g., trailing commas, missing brackets)
- /validate-output: Checks AI output for length, format, schema compliance, and blocked patterns
- /generate-structured: Produces valid, typed JSON responses from prompts using any custom schema
- All services require no API keys or subscriptions; payments handled via the x402 protocol (USDC on Base)
- Part of Reno Labs’ AEA Arena service fleet
